answer: The system gives weight only to identities signed by a hardware attestation key sealed in one device, so each fake needs a separate device whose key cannot be copied. During an audit, the operator opens the case, confirms its interior is hollow except for the one chip, pours 10 milliliters of nectar through its cooling channel to prove it is unblocked, and weighs a juniper spacer removed from the case. A spacer lighter by more than 0.2 grams, a second chip, or a blocked channel fails, zeroes weight for 90 days, so 50 fakes need 50 devices.
